checks.name: simulator-build
argv:
set -eu
fail() { printf '%s\n' "Swift iOS configuration: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
[ -n "$1" ] && [ -n "$2" ] || fail 'supply explicit -project/-workspace and repository-relative project/workspace path in .litefactory/stack.overrides.json'
[ -n "$3" ] || fail 'supply the repository shared scheme in .litefactory/stack.overrides.json'
[ -n "$4" ] || fail 'supply an explicit iOS 26.2 simulator destination in .litefactory/stack.overrides.json'
case "$1:$2" in -project:*.xcodeproj|-workspace:*.xcworkspace) ;; *) fail 'expected -project with .xcodeproj or -workspace with .xcworkspace';; esac
case "$2" in /*|../*|*/../*|*/..|..) fail 'project/workspace path must stay inside the repository';; esac
[ -d "$2" ] || fail 'project/workspace directory is missing'
case "$3" in -*) fail 'shared scheme cannot begin with a dash';; esac
case "$4" in 'platform=iOS Simulator,'*'OS=26.2'*) ;; *) fail 'destination must select iOS Simulator and OS=26.2';; esac
set -eu
fail() { printf '%s\n' "Swift iOS configuration: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
[ "$(uname -s)" = Darwin ] || fail 'requires macOS 15.6–26.x'
case "$(sw_vers -productVersion)" in 15.[6-9]|15.[6-9].*|15.[1-9][0-9]*|26|26.*) ;; *) fail 'requires macOS 15.6–26.x';; esac
developer=$(xcode-select -p)
case "$developer" in */Xcode*.app/Contents/Developer) ;; *) fail 'requires full Xcode and matching selected developer directory';; esac
[ "$(xcrun --find xcodebuild)" = "$developer/usr/bin/xcodebuild" ] || fail 'selected developer directory does not match xcrun xcodebuild'
case "$(xcodebuild -version)" in 'Xcode 26.3
'*) ;; *) fail 'requires Xcode 26.3';; esac
case "$(xcrun swift --version)" in *'Swift version 6.2.3 ('*) ;; *) fail 'requires Swift compiler 6.2.3';; esac
[ "$(xcrun --sdk iphonesimulator --show-sdk-version)" = 26.2 ] || fail 'requires iOS 26.2 simulator SDK'
[ "$(xcrun --sdk iphoneos --show-sdk-version)" = 26.2 ] || fail 'requires iOS 26.2 device SDK'
xcrun simctl list runtimes | grep 'iOS 26.2 ' | grep -v 'unavailable' >/dev/null || fail 'operator must prepare the iOS 26.2 simulator runtime'
exec xcodebuild "$1" "$2" -scheme "$3" -destination "$4" -sdk iphonesimulator -derivedDataPath .litefactory/swift-ios/DerivedData CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO SWIFT_VERSION=6 build
